title: BTC 两天退出 + 七天冷却组合验证
rules: 新组合仅叠加 TREND_EXIT_DAYS=2 与 RECOVERY_COOLDOWN_DAYS=7。原入场、标的两天退出、账户降仓及恢复、风险重启14天间隔、分币独立预算和槽位保持原版。比较原版、两个单项、组合与持有，检查组合是否改善单项而不是仅比原版更好。
assessment: 综合最终收益、回撤、熊市损失、周期取舍；无5pp硬门槛
source_selection: Two retained exploratory candidates from prior 19-window study; not independent validation
assessment_result: No clear general advantage from combining: preserve research results, prioritize BTC two-day single candidate; no production switch.
